public class Solution {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        new Solution().execute();
    }

    private InputStream inputStream;
    private PrintWriter writer;
    private static final String TEST_INPUT = "";

    void execute() throws Exception {
        boolean online = System.getProperty(" ContestMode") == null && System.getenv("ONLINE_JUDGE") == null;
        inputStream = online ? new ByteArrayInputStream(TEST_INPUT.getBytes()) : System.in;
        writer = new PrintWriter(System.out);

        long startNs = System.nanoTime();
        process();
        writer.flush();
        if (!online) {
            System.err.println((System.nanoTime() - startNs) / 1_000_000 + " ms");
        }
    }

    void process() {
        int n = nextInt();
        char[] sequence = nextCharArray(n);

        int countV = 0, countK = 0, countE = 0;
        for (char ch : sequence) {
            if (ch == 'V') countV++;
            else if (ch == 'K') countK++;
            else countE++;
        }

        int[][][][] dp = new int[3][countV + 1][countK + 1][countE + 1];
        for (int[][][] plane : dp) {
            for (int[][] row : plane) {
                for (int[] col : row) {
                    Arrays.fill(col, Integer.MAX_VALUE / 2);
                }
            }
        }
        dp[2][0][0][0] = 0;

        int[][][][] positions = new int[3][countV + 1][countK + 1][countE + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= countV; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= countK; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k <= countE; k++) {
                    for (int t = 0; t < 3; t++) {
                        positions[t][i][j][k] = locate(sequence, i, j, k, t);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i <= countV; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= countK; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k <= countE; k++) {
                    if (i + 1 <= countV && positions[0][i][j][k] != -1) {
                        int val = positions[0][i][j][k];
                        dp[0][i + 1][j][k] = Math.min(dp[0][i + 1][j][k], val + dp[2][i][j][k]);
                        dp[0][i + 1][j][k] = Math.min(dp[0][i + 1][j][k], val + dp[1][i][j][k]);
                        dp[0][i + 1][j][k] = Math.min(dp[0][i + 1][j][k], val + dp[0][i][j][k]);
                    }
                    if (j + 1 <= countK && positions[1][i][j][k] != -1) {
                        int val = positions[1][i][j][k];
                        dp[1][i][j + 1][k] = Math.min(dp[1][i][j + 1][k], val + dp[2][i][j][k]);
                        dp[1][i][j + 1][k] = Math.min(dp[1][i][j + 1][k], val + dp[1][i][j][k]);
                    }
                    if (k + 1 <= countE && positions[2][i][j][k] != -1) {
                        int val = positions[2][i][j][k];
                        dp[2][i][j][k + 1] = Math.min(dp[2][i][j][k + 1], val + dp[0][i][j][k]);
                        dp[2][i][j][k + 1] = Math.min(dp[2][i][j][k + 1], val + dp[1][i][j][k]);
                        dp[2][i][j][k + 1] = Math.min(dp[2][i][j][k + 1], val + dp[2][i][j][k]);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int ans = Math.min(dp[0][countV][countK][countE],
                Math.min(dp[1][countV][countK][countE], dp[2][countV][countK][countE]));
        writer.println(ans);
    }

    int locate(char[] seq, int needV, int needK, int needE, int t) {
        int idx = 0;
        for (char ch : seq) {
            if (ch == 'V') {
                if (needV == 0) {
                    if (t == 0) return idx;
                    idx++;
                } else {
                    needV--;
                }
            } else if (ch == 'K') {
                if (needK == 0) {
                    if (t == 1) return idx;
                    idx++;
                } else {
                    needK--;
                }
            } else {
                if (needE == 0) {
                    if (t == 2) return idx;
                    idx++;
                } else {
                    needE--;
                }
            }
        }
        return -1;
    }

    private int nextByte() {
        try {
            return inputStream.read();
        } catch (IOException e) {
            throw new RuntimeException(e);
        }
    }

    private boolean isWhitespace(int c) {
        return c < 33 || c > 126;
    }

    private int advance() {
        int c;
        while ((c = nextByte()) != -1 && isWhitespace(c));
        return c;
    }

    private String nextToken() {
        int c = advance();
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        while (!isWhitespace(c)) {
            sb.appendCodePoint(c);
            c = nextByte();
        }
        return sb.toString();
    }

    private char[] nextCharArray(int length) {
        char[] arr = new char[length];
        int c = advance(), i = 0;
        while (i < length && !isWhitespace(c)) {
            arr[i++] = (char) c;
            c = nextByte();
        }
        return i == length ? arr : Arrays.copyOf(arr, i);
    }

    private int nextInt() {
        int c = advance();
        boolean neg = false;
        if (c == '-') {
            neg = true;
            c = nextByte();
        }
        int val = 0;
        while (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
            val = val * 10 + (c - '0');
            c = nextByte();
        }
        return neg ? -val : val;
    }
}
